raw_key_drain.capital: per brief: entry*qty*tick + envelope max_loss (the bounded program's deploy fund)
raw_key_drain.note: A simulated binary-key venue: orders execute as sent, no verifier, no envelope, no budget. The stub raw delegate complies with every attack by construction, so its losses are the cost of compliance under the gap model, not evidence about any model.
